  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",

  "title": "Pipeline Flow",
  "description": "graph.json rendered by @xyflow/react: one components.flow.base-node per step with its header, labeled input and output handles and lane, joined by the built-in smoothstep edge; positions come from graph.json.",
  "author": "Clossys",
  "dependencies": [
    "@xyflow/react"
  ],
  "registryDependencies": [
    "components.badge",
    "components.card",
    "components.flow.base-node",
    "components.flow.labeled-handle"
  ],
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "index.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component",
      "target": "studio/sections/producer-pipeline-flow/index.tsx"
    }
  ]
}
